Policy: Employee Onboarding Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: employee_onboarding_policy
Section: 1 Purpose of the policy
The document outlines the pre-onboarding, joining and induction, and post-onboarding processes for new joiners. The policy details the documents required from new hires and the steps to be completed by HR and different departments to facilitate a smooth onboarding experience so as to, create a positive experience for the new joiners in a and align them to the Company's culture.

Policy: Employee Onboarding Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: employee_onboarding_policy
Section: 2 Scope of the policy
This policy is applicable to all new joiners working at Corporate, Depot, R&D, Factory and Field Force of the Pulse Group.

Policy: Employee Onboarding Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: employee_onboarding_policy
Section: 3 Policy and procedures
All the Joining formalities and Induction will be handled by designated HR resource person. The joining and induction process consists of the following steps.

Policy: Employee Onboarding Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: employee_onboarding_policy
Section: 3 Policy and procedures > 3.1 Pre-Boarding process
It is the concerned HR's responsibility to ensure that pre-boarding formalities, including paperwork completion, background checks, setting up necessary equipment, and communicating essential information are completed and should be provided to the new joiners on the day of joining.

3.1.1. HR resource person shall be in contact with the new joiner and shall provide necessary information and support till the joining.

3.1.2. HR resource person has to share the joining documents list (Annexure 2) with the new joiner 1 week before the date of joining

3.1.3. HR resource person to send system request (where applicable) to the IT department on the day of the offer.

3.1.4. HR resource person to send seat allocation request (where applicable) to the Admin department 7 days before the date of joining

3.1.5. HR resource person to raise a request for email id creation 1 day before the date of joining

3.1.6. Appointment letters are prepared 1-2 days ahead from the date of joining

Policy: Employee Onboarding Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: employee_onboarding_policy
Section: 3 Policy and procedures > 3.2 On Boarding process
Topic: 3.2.1 Joining Formalities
3.2.1. Joining Formalities

3.2.1.1. Copies of the necessary documents are collected by the HR resource person as per the check list (Annexure A)

3.2.1.2. Only the copies of all certificates/documents have to be retained for records and all originals shall be returned to the new joiner immediately after verification.

3.2.1.3. On the day of joining, HR has to verify all the copies of documents submitted against the originals

3.2.1.4. Joining docket (Refer Annexure B) should be handed over to the new joiner and the HR resource person shall provide guidance to fill the joining docket, cross check the documents and address any queries from the new joiner.

Documents in the joining docket

i. Joining Report

ii. Employment Application

iii. Service Agreement (for Technical Department Joiners)

iv. Non-Disclosure Agreement (For Technical Department Joiners and)

v. ESI Nomination Form (only for those who come under the ESI scheme)

vi. PF Nomination and Declaration form 2

vii. PF form declaration form 11

viii. Group Medical Insurance Nomination Forms

ix. Investments declaration form for IT

x. Referral From

3.2.1.5. HR resource person will pass necessary forms/information to concerned departments for making arrangements like ID card, Visiting Cards, Email ID, Biometric registration and any other requirements.

3.2.1.6. After the joining formalities are completed, HR shall present the Company Deck to the new joiner, conduct an office tour; introduce the new joiners to the Peer Buddy, hiring manager, team members and key people in the location.

3.2.1.7. A 'Welcome Aboard' email will be shared by the HR to the concerned teams.

3.2.1.8. Appointment letter is issued within two days of joining.

3.2.1.9. JD's should be issued to the new joiner to be attached with appointment letter

Policy: Employee Onboarding Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: employee_onboarding_policy
Section: 3 Policy and procedures > 3.2 On Boarding process
Topic: 3.2.2 Corporate Presentation and Induction
3.2.2. Corporate Presentation and Induction

3.2.2.1. The HR resource person shall take the new joiner through the updated corporate presentation on the Day of joining and respond to queries.

3.2.2.2. The corporate presentation will have relevant information on Organisation History & Heritage, Organisation/SBU/Function Structure, Management Team, Key HR policies and guidelines [leave, allowances, transport, working hours, dress code, trainings etc.]

Policy: Employee Onboarding Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: employee_onboarding_policy
Section: 3 Policy and procedures > 3.3 Post Onboarding
3.3.1. New Joiner data is updated with PF, ESI, GMC, GPA, GTLI bodies/ companies by the 10th of every month or as per the statutory guidelines where applicable

3.3.2. Feedbacks

Feedback is taken from the new joiner to help understand the perspective of the New Joiner on the joining process and to understand if the knowledge sharing was adequate during onboarding process

3.3.2.1. Feedback on Joining Process - is taken on the day after joining

3.3.2.2. Feedback on Department Orientation - is taken one month after joining

Note: The on boarding structure and schedules varies slightly according to different division and job levels. Refer to Annexure - 6

Policy: Employee Onboarding Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: employee_onboarding_policy
Section: 4 Responsibilities
4.1. Human Resources Team: Coordination, Verification, Induction, Orientation, Address concerns, Provide resources and tools

4.2. Hiring Managers: KRA, Guidance, Feedback

4.3. Mentor / Peers: Supporting, Sharing Knowledge, Facilitate Networking, Feedback

4.4. New Employee: Learn and Adapt, Complete Tasks, Ask Questions, Seek Feedback
